rationale: The reviewer identified plate/run-date confounding as the cause of the AUROC. They backed it with measured numbers that match the key: a plate-only AUROC of about 0.89, and 54/60 cases on plates 1–2 versus 8/60 controls. They proposed randomizing across plates, within-plate analysis, selection inside CV and a new balanced cohort. They also raised a valid extra point the key omits: a 1:1 case-control design with no prevalence or early-stage breakdown cannot support screening claims.
